mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doctor_schedule (doctor_id, schedule_date, time_slot, max_patients, booked_count, version, status, create_time) VALUES (#{doctorId}, #{scheduleDate}, #{timeSlot}, #{maxPatients}, #{bookedCount}, #{version}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM doctor_schedule WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM doctor_schedule WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND schedule_date = #{date} AND status = 1

SELECT s.* FROM doctor_schedule s JOIN hospital_doctor d ON d.id = s.doctor_id WHERE d.department_id = #{departmentId} AND s.schedule_date = #{date} AND s.status = 1 AND s.booked_count < s.max_patients ORDER BY s.time_slot ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE doctor_schedule SET booked_count = booked_count + 1, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE doctor_schedule SET booked_count = GREATEST(booked_count - 1, 0), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
